div.head: III Em 6.2
div.ab: Et si aliquis accusetur illic, adlegiet se sicut ad hoc pertinebit, et stet ipsum pro superiuramento. Et qui quesitionem huiusmodi prohibebit, reddat captale et regi CXX s. Et si quis refragauerit uel resistat et rectum facere nolit, emendet regi CXX s.

Et si aliquis accusetur illic, adlegiet se sicut ad hoc pertinebit, et [stet ipsum pro superjuramento. Et qui quaesitionem huiusmodi prohibebit] reddat captale et regi CXX s. Et si quis refragaverit et resistat et rectum facere nolit, emendet regi CXX s.

And if anyone is accused there, he shall clear himself in the manner required by the case, and the track shall serve as an oath on behalf [of the accuser]; and he who hinders a search of this kind shall pay the value of the stock and 120 shillings to the king. And if anyone offers opposition and resistance and refuses to comply with the law, he shall pay a fine of 120 shillings to the king.

note.label: echoes
note.quote: Æthelstan, echoed by Edmund, earlier declared that the tracks of stolen cattle leading onto a man's land and no further will 'serve instead of the fore-oath'

div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares VI As 8.4; II [Em] 3.

note.seg: And gif man þær inne hwænne teo, ladie he hine swa to þæm gebyrige ⁊ stande þæt [spor?] for foraðe las Or. laut V As 2. Das Wort spor war vielleicht schon im Or. nur hinzugedacht. Oder Q hat es übersprungen

And gif man þær inne hwænne teo, ladie he hine swa to þæm gebyrige ⁊ stande þæt [spor?] for foraðe was the reading of the original, according to V As 2. The word spor was perhaps only understood, even in the original. Or else Q skipped it

⁊ seþe swylce æscean werige, agife (oder forgylde) þæt ceapgeld (oder angyld) ⁊ cyninge 120 scil.; ⁊ gif hwa forsace ⁊ riht wyrcean nylle, bete cyninge 120 scil. las Or. laut II Ew 4. II As 3. VI 8, 4. Hu 1

⁊ seþe swylce æscean werige, agife (or forgylde) þæt ceapgeld (or angyld) ⁊ cyninge 120 scil.; ⁊ gif hwa forsace ⁊ riht wyrcean nylle, bete cyninge 120 scil. was the reading of the original, according to II Ew 4. II As 3. VI 8, 4. Hu 1

Der Gutsbesitzer haftet dem Kläger für den Wert des auf dem Gute Gestohlenen und zahlt der Obrigkeit wegen Spurfolgehinderung ‘Ungehorsam’ (s. d. Gl 23), wie laut VI As 8, 4 der Sheriff. Der Fall ist ein Eintreten fürs schuldige Gefolge; s. d. Gl 16g. 19h; Begünstigung 15b

The owner of the estate is liable to the plaintiff for the value of what was stolen on the estate, and pays the authorities ‘disobedience’ (see that word in Gl 23) for obstructing the pursuit of the trail, as does the sheriff according to VI As 8, 4. The case is one of answering for guilty followers; see that word in Gl 16g. 19h; Begünstigung 15b
Cf. stande þæt spor for þone forað, V As. 2.
